recorded_from_commit_note: Recorded against this card's own implementation: the solved answer page's caption (BookPDFGenerator._draw_solved_slot's step 8, shared since CARD-202 by both a full solved page -- solved_puzzle_page -- and a packed small-answer slot -- _packed_answer_page) now right-aligns with placement.drawing_right (anchor "rm" instead of "mm") and sits a fixed ANSWER_TILE_GAP_MM (2.0 mm) gap above placement.drawing_bottom instead of centred across the whole bottom slack; the omission guard widens from `slack >= line_height` to `slack >= gap_px + line_height` to match. Because the caption logic is the one shared implementation CARD-202 already extracted, this one change reaches both the full-page and the packed-slot answer pages -- no separate fix was needed for the packed path.
read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages — the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-203 moves the caption's own ink on every answer page whose caption is actually drawn -- this book's three answer pages, 11 (Duck+Owl, CARD-202's packed 2-up), 12 (Tree, packed alone) and 13 (Snowflake, CARD-198's full page) -- all of which have slack below the drawing on this book's own Book 1 profile. Pages 1-10 (guide, TOC, dividers and puzzle pages) carry no caption at all and are byte-identical to CARD-200's own recording; only 11-13 moved. interior_bytes grows from 3420073 to 3421901 (the caption's own glyphs sit at different x/y pixels and against a different piece of background on each of the three answer pages, which changes each page's own JPEG stream length).
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like with CARD-203's right-aligned, closer solved-page caption in place. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, and an interior_bytes/colour_interior_bytes that no longer matches means the written file changed. If a later card deliberately changes either, it records a NEW baseline in a commit of its own, with its own card number, and says so here.
interior_colorspace_note: What every page of this interior declares (CARD-147's own fact, unaffected by CARD-201). NOT the same as each page entry's 'mode' below, which is 'RGB' and always will be: that field is what tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages normalises every page to before digesting it, regardless of the file's own declared colour space.
font_fingerprint_note: This machine's Arial-or-fallback fingerprint, reproduced before this file was written (tests.helpers.book_corpus.font_fingerprint). A machine with a different fingerprint skips the font_dependent_pages below rather than failing on them.
font_dependent_pages_note: Both guide pages (1, 2), the new TOC page (3, CARD-200: its title and every entry are set through _guide_face, the same Arial-or-fallback path the guide and divider pages already use), the three level dividers (4, 6, 8) and the SOLUTIONS divider (10) are machine-lettered. None of the three packed/full answer pages (11-13) are machine-lettered -- a packed slot's band and caption letter in the packaged DejaVu Sans, and so does every page's own new folio (CARD-200: it reuses _band_font, the same packaged face, exactly as the answer caption does -- G-4's reuse, not a new font path), so the folio never makes an otherwise machine-safe page machine-dependent.
interior_bytes_note: The black-and-white interior of this book: 3421901 bytes, where CARD-200's own recording held 3420073. The difference is the caption's own glyphs sitting at a different position on each of the three answer pages (11-13); no page's size or layout changed.
colour_interior_bytes_note: The same book with a COLOUR interior: 3918574 bytes, where CARD-200's own recording held 3916734. Read by tests/test_book_pdf_ink_mode.py only to show the length is longer than the black-and-white file's, never compared byte-for-byte against any earlier recording (that module's own TestBookInk_ColourInteriorIsUnchanged compares the two live exports to each other instead, page for page, not against a positional fixture -- see its own docstring).
changed_pages_note: Only the three answer pages moved: 11 (Duck+Owl, packed), 12 (Tree, packed alone) and 13 (Snowflake, full page) -- the only pages on which _draw_solved_slot's step 8 actually draws a caption on this book (every one of them has slack below its drawing). Pages 1-10 (both guide pages, the TOC, the three level dividers, the two-up page, the two single puzzle pages and the SOLUTIONS divider) carry no caption and are byte-identical to CARD-200's own recording -- confirmed by direct digest comparison while building this fixture, not assumed.
